about: The shared vectors of the pools (TFN OS P4 stage 2). Made by tests/unit/test_pool_crypto.py --update. All keys are TEST keys from fixed labels. Hex = lower case. All numbers little endian.
notes: roster: "TFNPOOL1", then records type(u8) length(u16) value, the signature record 0x7F last. The writer order: 01 02 03 04 05, 06 (A, then R), 07 (the members), 08 when there is one, 09, 7F.

roster 0x02: the pool name, 1..24 bytes of UTF-8, no 0 byte at the end. 0x07: ID(8) pk(65) MAC(6) role(1) flags(1) name(16: UTF-8, 0 bytes after it). 0x08: the LAN URL, one 0 byte, the VPN URL (each 0..63 bytes). 0x09: u64 (seconds).

roster 0x7F: key ID(8) + r(32) + s(32) (big endian, as fw_sign.py). The key ID = the first 8 bytes of SHA-256(the 65-byte point), as the key ID of the signed OTA. ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 over all bytes before the type byte of the 0x7F record (the magic too). A signature with a high s is good.

roster parse: a fault = an unknown type below 0x80, a record that goes past the end, a fixed type with another length (01:16 03:4 04:4 05:4 06:65 07:97 09:8 7F:72), 01 02 03 04 05 08 09 two times, 01 02 03 04 05 09 missing, 1..2 admin keys (not the same key two times, first byte 04), 1..17 members (no MAC and no ID two times, role 0..2, the pk starts with 04), 08 with no 0 byte or a URL over 63 bytes, a record after 7F, no 7F, a file over 4096 bytes. A type from 0x80 up (before 7F) is skipped.

roster rules (roster_rules.want): the order of the checks = form; sig (the key ID names an admin key of the NEW roster and the signature verifies); then for a JOIN (join_admin given): admin (the signer is not the JOIN admin key), the version floor is NOT checked (a new pool after a person tap or the token JOIN), member (the own ID is not in it), take; else: other (no stored pool or another pool ID), admin (the signer is not an admin key of the STORED roster), old (version <= rv), removed (the own ID is not in it), take.
derive: HKDF-SHA256(ikm = pool key, salt = pool ID, info = text || epoch u32): "TFN link4" 16, "TFN ptag" 1, "TFN beacon1" 32, "TFN hint" 4 bytes.

frame v4: AL 04 app kind len ch ptag ctr(u32) data, tag = SipHash-2-4(link, sender MAC(6) || the frame bytes before the tag), the 8 bytes of the u64 result little endian. frame_open order: not "AL" 04 or under 8 bytes = form; byte 7 not our ptag = other; len > 230 or the size not 20 + len = form; the MAC not a roster MAC = who; the tag = bad; then the counter window = old. A frame of the previous epoch has the ptag of that epoch: in its hour the receiver also takes that ptag and checks the tag with the previous link key (frames[prev_epoch]).
window: per member, hi + 64 bits (bit i = hi - i seen). The first counter is good and sets hi. c > hi = good (shift). hi - c >= 64 = old; a bit that is set = old.

udp v2: the call = AC 02 from(6) to(6) op, the invite = AI 02 from(6) app(20, 0 at the end); then ptag, ctr(u32), SipHash(link, from(6) || all bytes before the tag). The counter is the same counter as the link frames of the sender, the receiver uses the same window. udp_open: the same order as frame_open.

beacon AP 01: hint(4) nonce(12) ChaCha20-Poly1305(beacon key, nonce, plain, aad = the first 7 bytes "AP" 01 hint) = 43 bytes + tag(16) = 78 bytes. plain = MAC(6) name(16) app(12) flags(1) ID(8), texts with 0 bytes after. beacon_open: not 78 bytes or not AP 01 = form; another hint = other; the tag = bad.
join packet AJ 01: MAC(6) ID(8) name(16) = 33 bytes, plain.

SAS = u32 LITTLE endian of the first 4 bytes of SHA-256("TFNSAS1" || E_m || E_b || N_m || N_b) mod 1000000; the text "%03d %03d". C = SHA-256("TFNJC1" || E_m || N_m). sig_b over "TFNJ1" || C || E_b || N_b (the device key), sig_m over "TFNJ1" || C || E_b || N_b || E_m || N_m (the admin key), bxs over "TFNBX1" || ID || bx.

seal: K = HKDF-SHA256(X25519 value, salt = C (JOIN) or the board ID (op=key), "TFNSEAL1", 32). An X25519 value of 32 zero bytes is refused. The envelope = nonce(12) || ChaCha20-Poly1305(K, nonce, epoch(u32) || pool key(32) || wk(32), aad = SHA-256(the roster file)) || tag(16) = 96 bytes.

web: X-TFN-Auth = <manager ID, 16 hex>.<counter, decimal, no sign>.<HMAC-SHA256(wk, "TFNWEB1" || bn(16) || counter u64 || method || " " || uri), 64 hex>, lower case hex. uri = the path and the query as sent. The board takes a counter higher than the last good one of this start. The manager ID = the device ID formula on admin key A: SHA-256("TFNID1" || A)[0..8].

api: GET /api/pool (no web password needed: public values) = {"state", "pool", "name", "v", "epoch", "role", "strict", "legacy", "members", "mgr", "bx", "bxs", "bn", "v4": {...}} + "id" (the device ID), "mac" (12 hex) and "join" ("none", "hello", "wait", "allowed"). POST /api/pool?op=<op> with a JSON body of hex fields: hello {"admin", "mid", "c"} (+ "auth" = the token for the token JOIN) -> {"eb", "nb", "pk", "id", "bx", "bxs", "sig"}; reveal {"em", "nm", "sig"} -> {"ok", "join"}; set {"roster"} + "env" in a JOIN (409 {"error":"wait"} until ALLOW); key {"em", "env"} + "roster" (the roster first, then the key; aad = the new roster); webpass {"pw"}. set, key and webpass need X-TFN-Auth (set in an allowed JOIN does not). The same roster bytes again = ok, no change. An error = 4xx {"error": "<code>"}: 401 auth, 409 wait / no_join, 400 form, 403 the roster rule (sig, admin, old, other, member).
console: "pool join" opens the JOIN screen; the board prints a line with "SAS" and the 3 + 3 digits at the reveal (and at "pool"); "pool allow <6 digits>" = the tap on ALLOW; "webpass set <pw>".
